assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished game title-screen environment illustration for a grounded indie freelance computer developer simulator. A carefully art-directed intimate small Korean apartment workstation in the evening, viewed at a three-quarter angle: one unbranded widescreen monitor on a real timber desk, mechanical keyboard, mouse, folded handwritten-free notebook, amber desk lamp, ceramic mug, small plant, cables neatly routed, a window with rain and distant neighborhood shop lights. Hand-painted 3D-render look, tactile matte materials, subtle grain, sophisticated warm amber versus slate-blue shadows, believable perspective and useful small details, cozy without cartoon exaggeration. Wide cinematic landscape 16:9. Important composition: workstation and lit monitor on right half, left 42 percent quiet dark blue wall and negative space for separately rendered title/menu. Monitor screen shows a restrained abstract dark desktop with small blank windows, NO readable text, NO code letters, NO logos. No people. No neon purple, no cyberpunk, no floating icons, no fake UI overlay, no watermarks, no excessive bloom. Full bleed, opaque background. This must look like premium game environment key art, not a website stock hero. Deliver the final raster image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustrated interactive neighborhood map background inside a premium indie computer-simulator game. A coherent small Korean neighborhood seen in elevated isometric three-quarter view, full town block composition inside a wide 16:9 landscape. Hand-painted miniature architectural diorama with believable softly rendered 3D materials, slate-blue evening shadows, warm cream walls, muted teal and terracotta roofs, pools of amber shop light. Three connected streets weave through the picture: six small ground-floor local shops on the near left (bakery, flower shop, bike shop, little library, stationery, clinic), six community buildings around a central pocket park (school, workshop, delivery garage, small museum, bookshop, market), and six modest creative and civic buildings on the upper right (community hall, photo studio, bus stop/depot, archive, tutoring room, a plaza with modest festival bunting). Visible walkable paths join them, trees and a few tiny faceless pedestrian silhouettes for scale. Buildings separated enough to place selectable game markers above them. Composition stays clean at small size; no dense city skyline, no skyscrapers, no floating islands. Gentle slightly painterly render, crafted game world instead of a generic infographic. NO words, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO map markers, NO interface, NO logos, NO watermark. Opaque full-bleed landscape illustration. Not cyberpunk, not neon, not hyper-saturated.
assets.edit: Edit the attached neighborhood game map. Preserve the exact composition, buildings, lighting, pedestrians, streets, colors and illustrative rendering. Only remove every tiny letter or pseudo-text from shop fascias, awnings, signboards and building plaques; replace those areas with natural blank material matching that surface. Retain simple pictorial symbols such as bicycle, camera, medical cross and clock. No readable or fake words anywhere. This is a game background that receives all labels separately in code. Do not add anything or reframe.
assets.usage: Desktop wallpaper and interactive contract map
